title: Epidural Neuroplasty for the Treatment of Herniated Lumbar Disk
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether epidural neuroplasty has better efficacy than epidural steroid injection for the treatment of lumbar disc herniation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* clinical diagnosis of herniated lumbar disc
* written informed consent obtained

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lumbar instability
* Piriformis syndrome
* Diabetes mellitus with uncontrolled blood glucose
* Severe osteoporosis
* Impaired function of cauda equina
* Severe sacral hiatus variation
* Interspinous ligament inflammation
* Myofascitis on lumbar and legs
* The third lumbar transverse process syndrome
